name: Baidu Netdisk
description: Baidu Netdisk file management and intelligent search. Supports browsing, keyword and semantic search, file organization, share links, storage usage queries, and transferring files from URLs.
authorization.title: Connect your Baidu Netdisk account
authorization.description: Authorize your account through the Baidu Netdisk Open Platform, then enter the Access Token in the POCO authorization form. Available files and tools depend on your account permissions.
authorization.token.label: Access Token
authorization.token.description: Enter only the token, not an authorization page address or an MCP URL containing a token. When the token expires, authorize again and enter a new token.
authorization.token.placeholder: Enter your Baidu Netdisk Access Token
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.browse.title: Files and storage
capabilities.browse.description: Browse folders and document, image, or video categories; query file metadata, account information, and storage usage.
capabilities.search.title: Keyword and semantic search
capabilities.search.description: Find files by filename keywords or natural language descriptions. Filters depend on the parameters supported by the current tools.
capabilities.manage.title: File organization and URL transfer
capabilities.manage.description: Create folders; copy, move, and rename files; save files from directly downloadable URLs to Netdisk.
capabilities.share.title: Create share links
capabilities.share.description: Create links with an expiry period and extraction code for selected files, then return the results to the current user.
limits.title: Scope and limits
limits.description: Only remote tools on the connector allowlist are exposed. Deletion, local downloads, and arbitrary local uploads are unsupported. Text saving is disabled pending verification of its tool name with an authorized account. All writes require confirmation. After a timeout, check the result before submitting again.
examples.title: Examples
examples.browse.title: Browse files and storage
examples.browse.description: Show the files in my Baidu Netdisk root directory and tell me how much storage is available.
examples.search.title: Search by description
examples.search.description: Find images and videos of beach sunsets in my Netdisk.
examples.copy.title: Organize research files
examples.copy.description: Create an AIGC research folder and copy the relevant files into it.
examples.share.title: Generate a share link
examples.share.description: Create a share link for Weekly Report.docx that expires in 7 days and uses a 4-character extraction code.
